# Soil

`material`

Loose earth under a biome's cover, down to its `topsoilDepth`. It is what mining a slice of natural topsoil yields, whatever cover (`surfaceMaterial`) it wears — Grass, Moss, Ash and Void ground alike — and what farmland is made of.

> Give digging the surface a yield that is not rock

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| density | decimal | g/cm³ |
| hardness | decimal | Mohs equivalent 1–10 |
| depthBand | json | Depth band [min, max) in world units below the natural surface where a vein may form; empty when max <= min. A topsoil layer, never a buried vein. |
| leyGated | boolean | True when a vein of this material forms only near a ley line |
| granular | boolean | True when a placed span of this material falls to the first support below it when undermined (Phase 137); rock, ores and metals stay put |
| rarity | `common`, `uncommon`, `rare`, `epic`, `legendary` | How rare the material is (the item rarity scale); clan tiers weigh buildings by it (Phase 203) |
| durability | integer | Base durability of a placed block; weather, age and damage lower it (StructureDurability, Phase 203). Packed earth. |
| structuralClass | `earth`, `wood`, `stone`, `concrete`, `steel`, `composite` | Structural class: the most floors a structure carrying this material may have (Structure.classes, Phase 203) |
